test_projects.notes: Contains deterministic DSL/FSM/stroke tests and a BenchmarkDotNet-backed EventsBenchmarkTest that should be filtered for reliability-only runs.
Contains deterministic script/config/gesture-machine tests plus machine-dependent hook and SendInput tests. Current uncommitted change wires GestureCoverageHarnessTests.cs into this project.

ci_safe_boundaries: Core DSL/FSM event replay using synthetic physical events
StrokeWatcher-driven replay when thresholds and wait boundaries are controlled
DefaultUserScript parse/compile/evaluate into RootElement when user directory is temporary
Coverage enumeration over RootElement When/On/Stroke/Do structure
diagnostic_or_manual_boundaries: SendInput event injection and hook capture
Cursor position and display scaling assertions

commands.reason: Plain local dotnet msbuild could not resolve System.Runtime.WindowsRuntime and System.Runtime.WindowsRuntime.UI.Xaml; CI installs legacy Windows SDK contracts before this build.

step_02_recommendations: Promote deterministic gesture replay helpers into non-benchmark app tests, or a shared helper file, with no Stopwatch pass/fail thresholds.
Add explicit default-script coverage assertions for wheel gestures and stroke gestures separately.
Use synthetic GestureMachine.Input sequences for RButton+WheelUp/WheelDown and RButton+stroke releases, not OS hooks or SendInput.
Keep hook, SendInput, cursor, foreground-window, and display-scaling checks out of CI reliability tests unless they are separately marked diagnostic/manual.
Use CI's sanitized Windows SDK setup for app-test builds, or document the local prerequisite before app-test build verification.
